description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeEducationDao class, which handles database operations related to employee education records within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for saving, retrieving, deleting, and searching employee education data, and is part of the Data Access Object layer in the application.

classes.name: EmployeeEducationDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for managing EmployeeEducation entities, providing methods for CRUD operations and search functionalities.

methods.name: saveEmployeeEducation
methods.description: Persists an EmployeeEducation entity to the database and returns it.

methods.name: getEmployeeEducationById
methods.description: Retrieves a specific EmployeeEducation record by employee number and education record id.

methods.name: getExistingEmpEducationIdsByEmpNumber
methods.description: Fetches existing EmployeeEducation record IDs for a given employee based on provided IDs.

methods.name: deleteEmployeeEducations
methods.description: Deletes multiple EmployeeEducation records for a given employee.

methods.name: searchEmployeeEducation
methods.description: Performs a search for EmployeeEducation records based on filter parameters and returns the matching entities.

methods.name: getSearchEmployeeEducationPaginator
methods.description: Creates a paginator object configured with search filters for EmployeeEducation entities.

methods.name: getSearchEmployeeEducationsCount
methods.description: Returns the count of EmployeeEducation records matching the search filters.
